editorial: Today's technology agenda highlights the recursive development processes of artificial intelligence models and security testing for autonomous systems. The release of the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model and academic studies on robotic navigation security point to a new threshold in hardware and software integration.

items.title: elayadesign/ai-design-skills
items.summary: elayadesign/ai-design-skills offers a collection of design skills consisting of markdown rule files that AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf) can read. This project provides a guide-like resource for AI-powered tools to standardize design processes.

snapshot.description: A growing collection of design skills for AI coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and anything else that reads a markdown rules file.

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark
items.summary: Nutlope/hallmark is a styling tool for code editing tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex that enables the production of designs that do not look like they were generated by AI. This project offers a design capability for developers who want to change the standard appearance of generative AI outputs.

snapshot.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.

items.title: nightly-labs/openbot
items.summary: nightly-labs/openbot is a locally-focused desktop application that provides persistent workspaces for AI models such as Codex, Claude, and Grok. It provides an environment that allows users to collaborate on file sharing, browser control, and AI agents.

snapshot.description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: obra/superpowers is a software development methodology and capability framework developed for AI agents that code. It aims to standardize software development processes for agents through composable skills and prompting instructions.

snapshot.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works. Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.summary: Developed in the Rust language, impeccable offers a design dictionary for AI agents that write code. This tool aims to prevent AI-generated erroneous content (AI slop) in the software development process through audit and review mechanisms.

snapshot.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.

items.title: makecindy/cindy
items.summary: Cindy is an open-source AI agent that allows you to create a personalized assistant by connecting your computer and phone devices. This tool, which allows users to integrate their existing model subscriptions, is designed to work out of the box.

snapshot.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。. Cindy is an open-source AI agent, ready out of the box and yours to shape. Connect your computers and phone, bring the models and subscriptions you already use, and build a companion that knows how you like to work.

items.title: gitroomhq/postiz-app
items.summary: Postiz is an agentic tool used for scheduling social media content. Developed in TypeScript, this application aims to automate content sharing processes.

snapshot.description: 📨 The ultimate agentic social media scheduling tool 🤖. To have the project up and running, please follow the Quick Start Guide

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.summary: affaan-m/ECC is a system developed to optimize the performance of AI agents. It provides a research-oriented development environment by offering capability, memory, and security layers for platforms such as Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and the code editing tool Cursor.

snapshot.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

items.title: HKUDS/DeepTutor
items.summary: DeepTutor is an AI-based workspace that combines learning processes such as private tutoring, problem-solving, exam creation, and visualization into a single system. Designed to meet the lifelong learning needs of students, this system aims to provide a personalized educational experience.

snapshot.description: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. DeepTutor is an agent-native learning workspace that connects tutoring, problem solving, quiz generation, research, visualization, and mastery practice in one extensible system.

items.title: JetBrains/thinkrail
items.summary: ThinkRail, developed by JetBrains, is an agent-based integrated development environment (IDE) that learns user work habits, personalizes itself, and can build its own capabilities over time. The project aims to improve the developer experience by analyzing software projects through living specs.

snapshot.description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need. ThinkRail is the agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it — learning your project through living specs today, and building its own capabilities tomorrow.

items.title: Ghostty 1.4
items.summary: Ghostty 1.4 is a new version update released for the terminal emulator Ghostty. It includes various bug fixes and improvements that enhance the software's performance and user experience.

items.title: US Government is hiding a secret court ruling about how it spies on Americans
items.summary: It is alleged that the United States government has hidden from the public a secret court order containing methods for the surveillance of citizens. This situation is sparking debates regarding the legal basis of the state's monitoring activities and principles of transparency.

items.title: Genie 4
items.summary: Genie 4, developed by DeepMind, represents a new generation in world simulation technology. This model stands out for its capacity to create interactive and dynamic environments from visual data.

items.title: Python's experimental JIT to be removed
items.summary: There are plans to remove the experimental just-in-time compiler feature in the Python programming language. This decision creates uncertainties regarding the future of this experimental structure in the development process.

items.title: New iMac with M6
items.summary: Apple has announced the new iMac model equipped with the M6 chip. The desktop computer has been updated for daily use and professional workflows with its high-performance processor.

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, shared on Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and text-based inputs. Compared to the previous version, it aims to reduce processing time and costs while offering performance increases in areas such as reasoning, coding, and visual analysis.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks. Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance–cost Pareto frontier across multiple agent harnesses.

items.title: RecursiveSI/flint
items.summary: Flint, developed by RecursiveSI, is a mixture-of-experts language model designed for coding-focused artificial intelligence agents. With a total of 39.8 billion parameters, the model is tasked with examining codebases, debugging, feature development, and writing tests.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. Flint is Recursive’s mixture-of-experts language model for coding agents, with 39.8 billion total parameters and approximately 2.5 billion active per token. It is designed to investigate codebases, fix bugs, implement features, and write tests.

items.title: Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B
items.summary: Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B is presented as an artificial intelligence model focused on text generation. Developers describe this model as a study aimed at transferring advanced agentic capabilities to smaller models through a high-capacity teacher agent.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. In Nanbeige4.3, we take a foundational step toward pushing the boundaries of lightweight agents. Our strategy centers on building a high-capacity teacher agent first, which will subsequently anchor the distillation of advanced agentic capabilities into smaller models.

items.title: XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B
items.summary: Spark-X2.6-4B, released on Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model with text-generation capabilities. Using the same architecture as its previous version, the model has been developed for on-device applications by offering higher performance in areas such as coding, reasoning, and multilingual operations thanks to post-training improvements.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. Spark-X2.6-4B retains exactly the same architecture as Spark-X2.5-4B, achieving its capability gains through improved post-training. It delivers substantial improvements in coding, agent, long-context, multilingual, reasoning, etc. These advances enable more capable and practical on-device AI for developers and users tackling real-world tasks.

items.title: black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy
items.summary: flux-3-image-klein-comfy, developed by Black Forest Labs, is an artificial intelligence model that provides image-to-image conversion. Shared on the Hugging Face platform, this model is designed to work compatibly with image generation tools such as ComfyUI.

snapshot.description: image-to-image model

items.title: Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face introduces an evaluation system called OSMA-Bench that measures safe movement adaptation based on obstacles in indoor robot navigation. The study proposes a new method called the Semantic Sensitivity Index to measure the ability of robots to adjust speed and distance according to object type and distance.

snapshot.description: Safe household navigation requires robots to regulate clearance and speed according to what an obstacle is and how close it is, without unnecessary conservatism. Yet existing evaluations do not test whether semantic safety distinctions are reflected in continuous motion. To that end, we introduce OSMA-Bench, an Obstacle-Conditioned Safe Motion Adaptation Benchmark built on spatially matched scenario sets that differ only in obstacle type. We also propose the Semantic Sensitivity Index (SSI), whi

items.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
items.summary: The Trinity, released on Hugging Face, presents a capability-focused recursive self-improvement method for multimodal artificial intelligence agents. The study aims to overcome scaling barriers such as the cost of creating heterogeneous environments and the slowness of manual iteration processes.

snapshot.description: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. items.title: PhysEvolve: Verifier-grounded Self-evolution for Physical Reasoning with Executable Worlds
items.summary: PhysEvolve is a method designed to address reliability issues that vision-language models experience in physical reasoning processes. It aims to bridge gaps in physical causality by using a self-evolving paradigm that allows the model to generate its own training data.

snapshot.description: Physical reasoning underpins how embodied systems understand and act in the physical world, yet vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable on questions about dynamics and physical causality. Progress is critically constrained by the scarcity of grounded counterfactual training data, as observational videos capture only the factual trajectory that occurred. items.title: MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching
items.summary: MoveBench is a rubric-based benchmarking tool developed to evaluate the performance of large language models (LLMs) in the fields of sports and health coaching. Unlike general-purpose tests, it offers specialized measurement in critical areas such as exercise safety, physiological suitability, and personalization.

snapshot.description: Despite rapid advances in large language models (LLMs), their deployment in the sports and health domain remains high-risk due to the absence of domain-specific evaluation benchmarks. Existing general-purpose benchmarks (e.g., MMLU and HELM) primarily assess broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities, but fail to capture critical domain requirements such as exercise safety, physiological appropriateness, personalization, and actionable coaching quality. items.title: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
items.summary: MLE-World, shared by Hugging Face, is a world model that predicts the results of machine learning experiments based on code and data descriptions. Fine-tuned based on Qwen3.5-4B, this system enables AI agents to work more efficiently by predicting error logs and validation scores without the need to train and run the models.

snapshot.description: AI research agents can propose, execute, and improve programs that solve machine learning tasks. However, executing each candidate program requires training and evaluating ML models, limiting how many candidates an agent can explore at each step. Modular capabilities that can be added to or combined with each other to perform different tasks.

The process of an individual continuing to acquire new knowledge and skills even after their formal education has ended.

Technical documents that are continuously updated as a software project evolves and reflect the current state of the project.
A concept representing the most advanced level reached in the field of artificial intelligence and the latest technological frontiers.

Technology developed by DeepMind that can realistically simulate the physical world or virtual environments.
A mechanism that helps speed up a program by enabling code to be translated into machine language instantly while it is running.
An artificial intelligence architecture developed by RecursiveSI that solves complex tasks by distributing them into smaller expert sections.
An artificial intelligence function offered by Nanbeige that can write meaningful texts based on given commands.
Advanced capabilities of artificial intelligence models such as planning, using tools, and completing tasks on their own.
An artificial intelligence process developed by Black Forest Labs that transforms an image into a different image based on a base image.
